spec.description:
DCTech Acoustic Barrier (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a
high-density, polymer-based asphalt-free synthetic soundproofing membrane
engineered to deliver exceptional airborne and impact noise reduction without
increasing structural thickness. Highly visco-elastic and adaptable, it acts as
an acoustic damping mass that breaks up structural resonance in drywall
partitions, ceilings, timber floors, metal roofs, and building service
enclosures. Distributed in Australia by DCTech, it is available in standard,
self-adhesive (SY), and composite felt (2FT) configurations.
features: High acoustic soundproofing performance without adding significant thickness
Visco-elastic damping material that reduces resonance and vibration
Asphalt-free, non-toxic, and bitumen-free polymer formulation

Self-adhesive
backing option (Tecsound SY) for direct application to plasterboard and metal

Hot and cold temperature resistant;
flexible down to -20°C

Self-extinguishing fire behaviour compliant with
Euroclass B, s2, d0

Effective airborne noise reduction (Rw up to 30 dB as
single sheet)
Substantial impact and rain noise damping on metal deck roofs
Suitable for horizontal, vertical, and curved building surfaces

technical.value: Tecsound 50: Rw 28 dB; Tecsound 70: Rw 30 dB

install:
Ensure substrate (plasterboard, metal,
concrete, or timber) is clean, dry, and dust-free

For self-adhesive Tecsound
SY, peel back release liner gradually while pressing membrane onto substrate

For non-adhesive Tecsound, apply contact adhesive evenly to substrate and
membrane

Apply firm pressure using a roller across the entire membrane to
eliminate trapped air

Overlap adjacent membrane sheets by 50mm or butt join
and seal joints with Tecsound S Band tape

Fasten mechanically with washers or
staples where installed overhead on ceilings

Cover with subsequent layer of
plasterboard or ceiling lining within manufacturer guidelines
selection_checklist:
Confirm whether airborne sound (walls/ceilings) or
impact/rain noise (floors/roofs) is being addressed

Select mass requirement
(Tecsound 50 at 5kg/m² vs Tecsound 70 at 7kg/m²)

Choose self-adhesive (SY)
for fast plasterboard/metal application or standard for adhesive bonding
Calculate total square metres including 50mm overlaps

Ensure ceiling or wall
framing can bear the 5kg/m² to 7kg/m² added dead load
accessories: Tecsound S Band (self-adhesive acoustic joint tape)
limitations:
Must not be left permanently
exposed to UV sunlight or weather

Not suitable as a foot traffic wearing
surface

Ceiling applications require mechanical fastening in addition to
adhesive bonding

Heavy weight requires adequate structural support and
multi-person handling during overhead installation

problem_keywords: rain noise drumming on metal roof
use_cases:
Bonding to plasterboard in ceiling assemblies under flight
paths to block aircraft noise

Laminating between plasterboard sheets on stud
partition walls to boost speech privacy

Damping rain noise impact on
residential and commercial standing seam metal roofs

Wrapping noisy waste
pipes and ventilation ducts to eliminate fluid flow noise
not_for: Direct exposed external roof or wall cladding

Walkable floor surface without
subfloor or overlay
retrieval.rag_summary:
DCTech Acoustic Barrier (Tecsound / Tecsound SY) is a
high-density, visco-elastic synthetic soundproofing membrane distributed in
Australia by DCTech. Formulated from asphalt-free polymers at 5.0 kg/m²
(Tecsound 50, 2.5mm) and 7.0 kg/m² (Tecsound 70 / SY 70, 3.5mm), it provides an
Rw of up to 30 dB as a single layer without adding significant wall or ceiling
thickness. Available with a self-adhesive backing (SY) or composite felt (2FT),
it dampens airborne noise, aircraft flyover rumble, and metal roof rain drumming
across walls, ceilings, floors, and building services. Rated Euroclass B, s2,
d0, non-toxic, and flexible down to -20°C, it is an advanced acoustic damping
membrane for high-performance building envelopes.
